# DRIFTWOOD

Survival on a drowned world. Steer a patched raft across the open sea, salvage wreckage for fuel and
scrap, and get home before the fuel runs out. Explore to discover new islands and log them on your map.
Storms roll in at night; the sea gets rougher and the engine burns more fuel.

## The loop

Explore → salvage → refuel → push further. Fuel is the clock: every trip is a decision about how far
to go before turning back. A low-fuel warning sounds at 25%. Discoveries are logged in the journal.

Controls: arrow keys or WASD to steer, Space to salvage when next to wreckage. On a phone, drag to steer.
